title: Satchel Paige's age and self-taught guitarists
summary: Albert and Satch palled around in Dallas; talk turns to untaught players who still make the right changes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Yeah. It's like, you know, who knows how old Satchel Paige is. Right. You know, I mean, could you guess?

Well, you make a guess. Uh, Satch and I used to, uh, pal around together. Uh, one time in Dallas, he felt like riding. He used to like to ride and he plays a guitar. He sat on the back of the car and ride. We never discuss Edge. I don't know why. But I do know this, that he's, he's older than me. And I was 64 years old in August. So I'm not gonna question Satchel's age. He's a little older than you. Yeah, if he says he's 29, that's his business, you know. Yeah.
No, I think he came out, I saw him on This Is Your Life, and he came out with his age.
Well, that's problematical too, because I saw the program and I don't think it was a definite answer. Yeah.
Well, maybe he didn't know, because they didn't keep records. Possibly so.
What did he play on the guitar?

Just play the blues and sing blues. Just simple chords. You know a lot of guys do this as a pastime, but sometimes you run into a fella who does it as a pastime, really gets some good music out of what he's doing. Uh huh.
It's great. Yeah, some guys can only play three chords, but what they do in three chords is great.
And to me, they're real musicians in that, in their limit, you know, you have to give them

a lot of credit. They're real artists, but limited. Well, sure. But he's never had a lesson in his life. What he's doing, he's just picked it up and went ahead. Well, so many musicians in the old days did that. And even today, even today, these young guys that are playing these guitars, they don't know music. They're listening to a record, they're learning this instrument some kind of way. I can't explain it how to do it, but they go right ahead and they make the correct changes and chords and play exactly what the other fellas play.
Yeah. So we had a great guitarist in Willis, Santiago.
